rawContent: We lost a giant today — our dear sister & courageous Afro-Brazilian leader, Marielle Franco. Praying for all who loved her & all who were impacted by her leadership. #BlackLivesMatter #SayHerName https://t.co/GMYMIGJ3MV

Grateful so many human rights defenders from around the globe are @ the UN CSW. Good 2 connect w/ our Brazilian sisters about their demands 4 justice for #MarielleFranco & others who’ve been murdered by police in Brazil. The world is watching.       #SayHerName #BlackLivesMatter
